description: SF assignment vectors (spec 02-physical-link.md §3.4). Stateless hash-based fallback assigned_sf = 7 + (hash_32(IID) % 6) where hash_32 = FNV-1a32 basis 0x811c9dc5 per CCP-15.8.3. Gateway-assigned and SF10 fallback included. Independent external oracle (no LICHEN code) matching Rust lichen-core and Python oracle.
